title: 7-Day Athens & Cairo Ancient Civilizations Tour
metaTitle: Athens & Cairo in 7 Days | Greece Egypt Journey
metaDescription: Explore Athens and Cairo in 7 days, from the Acropolis and Classical Greece to the Pyramids of Giza and the remarkable treasures of ancient Egypt.
breadcrumb: Explore Our Travel Destinations & Multi-Country Tours
summary:
The 7-Day Greece & Egypt Tour connects Athens and Cairo in a compact itinerary focused on two major centers of ancient civilization. Begin in Athens with guided visits to the Acropolis and other classical landmarks before flying to Cairo. The Egyptian portion centers on the Pyramids of Giza and Cairo’s principal historical sites, creating a clear transition from ancient Greece to ancient Egypt without adding island stays or a Nile cruise.
The escorted program operates from April to October and includes selected 4-star hotels, breakfast, professional local guides, guided-tour entrance fees, airport transfers, scheduled sightseeing and the one-way Athens–Cairo flight.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Athens
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Athens International Airport. Meet and transfer to your hotel in Athens.
Check-in after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Full day Saronic Island Cruise
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Transfer to Port of Piraeus for a full-day cruise to the Saronic Islands. Visit Hydra, Poros, and Aegina, with free time for walking, shopping, or swimming. Lunch will be served onboard during the cruise. Return to Athens in the evening. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Overday Trip Delphi
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Depart for a full-day excursion to Delphi via Thebes, Livadeia, and the mountain village of Arachova. Visit the Sanctuary of Apollo, the Treasury of the Athenians, the famous Temple of Apollo, and the impressive Delphi Archaeological Museum. After the tour, return to Athens. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Athens City Tour - Flight to Cairo
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Start a city tour of Athens, including visits to the Acropolis of Athens, the Acropolis Museum, and the famous Parthenon. Continue to see the Hellenic Parliament, the Panathenaic Stadium, the Temple of Olympian Zeus, and Hadrian's Arch. In the early evening, transfer to Athens International Airport for your flight to Cairo. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Giza Pyramids and Sphinx Tour
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Meet your guide and begin the sightseeing tour. Visit Memphis, the ancient capital of Egypt, and see the colossal statue of Ramesses II. Continue to Saqqara to explore the famous Step Pyramid of Djoser. Later, visit the legendary Giza pyramid complex and the iconic Great Sphinx of Giza. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Old Cairo & Grand Egyptian Museum
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Visit the impressive Grand Egyptian Museum and the historic Cairo Citadel, including the beautiful Mosque of Muhammad Ali, also known as the Alabaster Mosque. Continue to Old Cairo to visit Church of Saints Sergius and Bacchus and the famous The Hanging Church. Later, explore the lively Khan el-Khalili Bazaar. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Cairo Airport
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Check out and transfer to Cairo International Airport according to your international flight departure time.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 7-Day Greece and Egypt Vacation?
faqs.a: The 7-Day Greece and Egypt Vacation covers Athens in Greece and Cairo in Egypt. This itinerary combines the birthplace of Western civilization with one of the world's oldest civilizations, offering travelers an unforgettable journey through history, culture, and iconic landmarks. The tour runs for 6 nights and 7 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 7-Day Greece and Egypt Vacation cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €1,995 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, guided sightseeing tours, selected meals, airport and hotel transfers, domestic transportation, and one domestic flight. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel category.

faqs.q: Are flights included in the package?
faqs.a: Yes, one domestic flight is included within the itinerary. Additional transportation is provided according to the tour program. International flights between countries and arrival/departure flights are not included unless specifically stated.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes accommodation in carefully selected hotels in Athens and Cairo. Daily breakfast is included, and additional meals may be provided according to the itinerary. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, quality service, and convenient locations.

Yes, professional English-speaking guides accompany the scheduled sightseeing tours in both Greece and Egypt. Your guides will provide fascinating insights into the history, culture, archaeology, and traditions of each destination.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Greece and Egypt?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors looking for a shorter introduction to Greece and Egypt. It combines the essential highlights of both countries in a convenient and well-balanced itinerary.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is easy to moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, museums, historic districts, and city centers. Most visitors with average fitness levels can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of the tour?
faqs.a: Highlights include the Acropolis, Parthenon, and historic neighborhoods of Athens, as well as the Pyramids of Giza, Great Sphinx, Egyptian Museum, and vibrant local culture of Cairo. The tour offers a fascinating contrast between the ancient civilizations of Greece and Egypt.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 7-Day Greece and Egypt Vacation?
faqs.a: Free cancellation is available up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms, airline conditions, and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Can the 7-Day Greece and Egypt Vacation be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade hotel categories, include destinations such as Santorini, Mykonos, Luxor, Aswan, or Alexandria, or modify the itinerary to suit your travel interests. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
